none: PAS CAM-5EC171: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD367-383
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD367-383. AD367-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI. Reverse shows Emperor standing holding shield and standard. Mint is Arles. See RIC IX, no.15. Obverse shows Bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Condition is fine, weight is 1.67g, diameter is 18.2mm
